senses.gloss:
Kauṇapatantri
XX. 13: 30. 1. Baudhāyana Śrautasūtra.
See Caland's edn. Vol. III. p. 30, l. 1. [Page104-a.

Kauṇapadanta
mentioned in Kauṭilya's Arthaśāstra, Mysore edn. 1909, p.. 14, 33, 321, 327.
This is a name of Bhīṣma.
Said to be the probable source for Bhadrabhūpāla's Nītiśāstramuktāvalī (Baddena Nītulu) in Telugu.
See J. of Sri Veṅk. Ori. Inst. I. iii. p. 111.

Kauṇḍaravyaśruti
Q. in Ānandatīrtha's Bhāgavatatātparyanirṇaya, Sarvamūla edn. p. 93a.

Kauṇḍinya
Vṛttikāra on Taitt. Saṁ. Q. in Bodhāyana gṛhya sūtra, III. 96.
C.. Kuṇḍina, NCC. IV. p. 190b.

Kauṇḍinya
authority on gr. ? ref. to in Taitt. Prāti. 5. 38 (an. its C. See JAOS. VII. p. 405), 18.3, 19.2.

Kauṇḍinya
(Sthavira) authority on gr. ref. to in Taitt. Prāti. 17. 4 an. C. of ibid. 5. 39-41. (See JAOS. VII. p. 405).

Kauṇḍinya
authority on dh. Q. by Nīlakaṇṭha in Śrāddhamayūkha; by Kamalākara in Nirṇayasindhu; by Bhaṭṭoji Dīkṣita in Tithinirṇayasaṁkṣepa (Lz. 548); in Vyavahāramātṛkā of Jīmūtavāhana (a prose passage on debt).
See Kane, HDS. I. p. 689b.
C.. Bṛhat Kauṇḍinya Smṛti, MD. 2659-60.

Kauṇḍinya
sage. mentioned in Carakasaṁhitā, Sūtrasthāna I. 20.

Kauṇḍinyadīkṣita
pupil of Murāri Bhaṭṭa.
--Tarkabhāṣāprakāśikā, a C. on Tarkabhāṣā. BORI. 208 of 1892-95. Br. Mus. 320. Hall p. 24. Jac. 697. K. 146. [Page104-b]

Kauṇḍinyabhagavat
--C. Bhāṣya on the Pāśupatasūtra.
Ed.. TSS. 143. 1940.

Kauṇḍinyaśikṣā
ref. to in C. on Sikṣāsamuccaya, TCD. 32B.

Kauṇḍinyaśruti
Q. by Ānandatīrtha(Madhva) in his Brahma Sūtra Bhāṣya.
See BNK. Sarma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. Vol. I. p. 354.

Kauṇḍinyasūri(ghoropāhva)
father of Bāvā Bhaṭṭa (a. of Pārthiveśvarārcanapaddhati, Rajapur 988).
